## Direct human correction ΓÇö concise reviewer-facing issues and PRs

At2026-10-06T02:43ΓÇô02:45UTC Matthew requested: ΓÇ£These should clearly describe the problem being solved, the high level solution, relevant technical details, and a test plan focused on clear evidence including screenshots.ΓÇ¥ He rejected dense iteration-process/workflow-state prose and instructed revision of implementation and QA guidance and current summaries. Further clarification: ΓÇ£Summaries should be relatively short and include what is necessary to help me understand the change, what it does, and prove that it works. It should not be an exhaustive record of development history.ΓÇ¥

The supplied screenshot shows issue413's Workflow current state section dominated by task IDs, machine/worktree paths, hashes and process history. This correction applies to reader-facing issue pages as well as current PR descriptions.

Required presentation: a concise concrete problem, high-level solution and intended outcome, only useful technical details, and a short behavioral Test plan with expected/observed results and representative visibly embedded genuine Before/After screenshots where required. Preserve exact source/base/capture/provenance in linked immutable evidence, with only the concise revision context necessary in the main body. Move full hashes, task IDs, paths, command inventories, receipt payloads, implementation iteration history and workflow bookkeeping into linked operational/evidence records and Project fields. Do not erase original requirements/history/evidence; retain them via preserved comments/records. Avoid padding a small change with an exhaustive test matrix or repetitive reports.

Independent QA must actually read the issue and final PR as a human reviewer, reject process-heavy or unnecessarily dense summaries, and verify that concise evidence still establishes correctness. Heading/word-count checks alone are insufficient. This is a communication-only correction unless a genuine code problem is found; do not rerun unaffected expensive suites. All source/evidence/append-only receipt, independent review and human merge/release gates remain.

Readiness is withheld for current summaries pending owner rewrite and same-QA reassessment. Coordinator removed human-ready from424/425/427;428 had no label at removal readback. Prior receipts remain historical for affected communication gates. Project entries must move to Sent back for iteration until revised descriptions and QA are verified. No merge, force-push, evidence deletion or runtime-pin migration.
